name: Cursor Studio v1.0.4
notes:
- Added English and Simplified Chinese interfaces with a title-bar language menu.
- Added automatic New API/Sub2API balances, provider cost multipliers, and 10-minute monitoring.
- Improved metric and Sonner animations, hardened online updates, and fixed QR assets, encoding, cost synchronization, and dynamic user-text translation.

- 新增英文与简体中文界面及标题栏语言菜单。
- 新增 New API/Sub2API 自动余额、供应商价格倍率和每 10 分钟定时监测。
- 优化指标与 Sonner 动画和在线更新，修复二维码资源、编码、费用同步及用户内容误翻译问题。
